preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 200,000.
The length of string t is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: at least one 'a' in s and at least one 'a' in t
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t contain at least one 'a'.

preconditions.expression: at least one 'b' in s and at least one 'b' in t
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t contain at least one 'b'.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is non-negative.
The number of operations is at most 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= len(s) for ai in operations)
postconditions.description: The lengths of the prefixes of s to swap are non-negative and do not exceed the length of s.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= bi <= len(t) for bi in operations)
postconditions.description: The lengths of the prefixes of t to swap are non-negative and do not exceed the length of t.

postconditions.expression: after n operations, one of the strings consists only of 'a' and the other consists only of 'b'
postconditions.description: After performing the specified number of operations, one of the strings will contain only 'a' and the other will contain only 'b'.
